name: Little company
line: A little warmth. A lot of room.
world: Matte clay, a sprout companion, peach and moss.
reason: Finch’s visible companion and Headspace’s unhurried focal point, with the review corpus’s pressure and reward interruptions removed. Open library rows borrow Keep’s directness.
layout: A companion sits in the middle of a quiet, open welcome. Large round voice control; open rows in the library; an airy writing page.
motion: Idle: 6-second 3px float, no pulsing mic. Hold: 120ms control compression plus a static recording ring. Waiting: separate three-dot indicator. Reply: subtle companion tilt. Release/route change cancels hold immediately.

name: Clear head
line: A brighter kind of breathing room.
world: Sculptural lilac loops, folded paper and a citron accent.
reason: How We Feel’s legible color grouping and Spotify’s strong action hierarchy, with Tiimo’s visual activity identity. Categories stay browsable and explicit preferences stay first.
layout: Bolder type and sculptural negative space. A tonal voice dock anchors Talk. Activities use alternating tonal group surfaces. Journal keeps the shape language at the edge.
motion: Idle: 8-second 2-degree sculpture drift. Hold: 120ms citron control compression and static recording ring. Waiting: three-dot state. Reply: 240ms shape settle. No looping full-screen shader.

name: Room to think
line: Less polish in your words. More you.
world: Ink, apricot paper, an ordinary cup and a loose pencil line.
reason: Day One’s readable writing space and Keep’s low-effort entry, with Headspace’s editorial art. Existing journal actions remain separate; decoration recedes as soon as writing starts.
layout: An editorial greeting and a conversational still life. A broad hold-to-talk action. The library is a clean illustrated index; the writing page is nearly unframed.
motion: Idle: 7-second 2px still-life drift. Hold: 120ms button compression and static recording ring. Waiting: three-dot state. Reply: 200ms ink-line reveal concept. No animated writing or delayed tools.
